body: Starter tip: TCV Food Bank's Marketplace is open Monday to Thursday 10 am to 2 pm, and Friday is drive-thru only from 10 to 11:30 am. First-time shoppers need an ID.
Starter tip: Dial 211 at any hour for free referrals to food, housing and health services in Alameda County.
Starter tip: The City's Senior InfoLine is 510-574-2041. You can leave a message in English, Spanish, Farsi or Mandarin.
